prompt: Why do muscles work in pairs, such as the biceps and triceps in your arm?

options.text: One muscle rests while the other grows
Pairs stop the bones from moving
A muscle can only pull, so its partner pulls the bone back

explanation: Muscles can only contract and pull; they cannot push. The triceps straightens the elbow that the biceps bent, each pulling the bone its own way.
